"Who Are You?" is the sixteenth episode of the fourth season of the American supernatural drama television series Buffy the Vampire Slayer. It was written and directed by series creator Joss Whedon and originally aired on The WB on February 29, 2000.

Nihilism is not the conclusion of Who Are You? (Buffy the Vampire Slayer) — it is the floor you stand on while examining it.
